overview: The Medford City Council ordained a Fire Department wage agreement, approved several infrastructure and public safety resolutions, and referred proposals for a citywide zoning review and the regional 911 system to subcommittees.

items.title: Citywide Street and Infrastructure Assessment
items.summary: The council approved a resolution requesting a comprehensive assessment of city streets, potholes, catch basins, and water and sewer infrastructure.

items.title: Fire Department Wage Ordinance
items.summary: The council ordained an amendment to the city personnel ordinance formalizing the Fire Department's negotiated compensation package.

items.title: Thermoplastic Crosswalk Markings Policy
items.summary: The council approved a resolution requesting that the city adopt a policy using reflective thermoplastic material instead of traditional paint for crosswalks.

items.title: School Emergency Notification Policy
items.summary: The council requested a copy of the school department's updated policy and methods for notifying parents during emergency and non-emergency incidents.

items.title: Drug Prevention Education in Schools
items.summary: The council requested updates on school drug prevention programs, as well as cost analyses to expand DARE officers into middle schools and follow-up protocols for Narcan administration.

items.title: Taxi License Transfer
items.summary: The council approved a petition from Unity Cab to transfer taxi medallion number 45 to a replacement vehicle.

items.title: Zoning Needs Analysis Proposal
items.summary: The council approved and referred to the zoning subcommittee a proposal to conduct a citywide zoning review and consider hiring an outside consultant.

items.title: Sidewalk Trackless Snowplow Purchase
items.summary: The council approved a resolution requesting the purchase of a trackless plow for city sidewalks, amended to include a DPW equipment audit and snow budget report.

items.title: Regional 911 System Review
items.summary: The council referred a discussion on the regional 911 system to the Public Safety Subcommittee for an April meeting with administration officials.

items.title: Motions and Resolutions
items.summary: The council approved resolutions congratulating Donna and James Basile on their 40th anniversary, requesting increased traffic enforcement on Ridgeway Road, and seeking clarification on Community Preservation Act tax abatement deadlines.
